headline: Wall Street Sinks as AI Sector Hype Fades and Anthropic IPO Struggles
summary: US markets experienced significant volatility as AI-linked stocks, including Nvidia and newly public Anthropic, saw sharp declines. The sell-off, which erased substantial market capitalization, reflects growing investor skepticism regarding the sustainability of AI valuations.
why: The AI sector has been the primary driver of US equity market gains in recent years. A correction in these high-growth, high-valuation stocks can trigger broader market pullbacks due to their heavy weighting in major indices like the Nasdaq and S&P 500.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index suffered its worst daily performance since 2020 due to the AI sector sell-off.
